name: Briar Arakawa
location: the Gray Zone, near Halsted and Chicago Ave

physical_description.heritage: Tricontinent blend with dominant South Asian (26.2%), Middle Eastern (25.3%), and East Asian (24.7%) ancestry, anchored by Pacific Islander warmth (18.0%) and subtle Northern European fairness (5.8%). The genetic mix creates striking angular cheekbones and defined facial structure from South Asian-Middle Eastern bone architecture, refined and sharpened by East Asian heritage, while Pacific Islander genetics add warm golden undertones and broader facial width. Northern European ancestry manifests as subtle fairness in skin luminosity rather than overt paleness.
physical_description.build: Stocky and broad-shouldered with maintained muscle tone despite age; years of physical work have given her solid, functional frame rather than aesthetic definition
physical_description.hair_color: Steel gray with natural dark roots showing
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, practical braid; functional rather than fashionable
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-bronze with golden-amber undertones; South Asian-Middle Eastern base enriched by Pacific Islander warmth creating a luminous bronze quality, with East Asian refinement adding subtle depth and Northern European fairness contributing cool luminosity beneath the warm surface
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and lined, especially around eyes and forehead; minimal makeup; scars on left cheekbone and jawline softened by age but still visible; skin shows sun damage and character. Pronounced cheekbones and defined angular facial structure from South Asian-Middle Eastern ancestry, refined by East Asian heritage into sharp jawline and high, prominent cheekbones. Pacific Islander genetics broaden and warm the overall facial presentation, softening the severity of the angularity with fuller cheek placement and wider facial structure.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running from left cheekbone down to jawline, approximately 8cm long
Small burn scar on inner right wrist, roughly 2cm diameter, pale and old
Faded tattoo on right forearm: a symbol combining geometric South Asian, Middle Eastern, and East Asian motifs, partially obscured by age and fading
Pronounced calluses on both palms and fingers from decades of handling tools and weapons
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible; augmentations are strictly subcutaneous if present at all—consistent with her philosophy of discretion
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate, economical grace; stands slightly forward on the balls of her feet as if always ready to move. Direct eye contact, minimal unnecessary gesture. Speaks slowly and rarely, but commands full attention when she does.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical wear: reinforced dark denim jacket with internal pockets, gray thermal base layer, heavy-duty canvas pants with cargo pockets. Black steel-toed boots, scuffed and well-maintained. Minimal jewelry—only a simple silver ring on left ring finger. No corp branding; all clothing is utilitarian, durable, and sourced from secondary markets. Watch is mechanical, not digital.
